Research · Engineering · Exploration

Ashish Kumar

Software Engineer and Independent Researcher

I am a software engineer and independent researcher exploring extended reality, human-centered AI, machine learning (ML), computer vision (CV) and quantum computing, with interests in agentic AI and robotics. My research spans mixed-reality interfaces, sustainable XR systems and human–AI collaboration. I build hands-free AR experiences, VR wellness environments and Python data workflows using Unity, Unreal Engine and Lens Studio.

  • Quantum ML Built atQuantumX Hackathon · KochiQuantumX Alzheimer's ClassificationA hybrid quantum-classical model that classifies Alzheimer's disease and mild cognitive impairment from 9 clinical features reduced to a 4-qubit circuit, with a Streamlit dashboard and explainability tools. On 39 OASIS-1 subjects the quantum classifier reached 76.5% accuracy against 77.5% for a classical SVM, and the project makes no claim of quantum advantage. Built for a quantum machine learning healthcare challenge; the repository is a fork of maxiemox/Quark_disease_classification.

    ContributionContributed to a team-built hybrid quantum–classical classification project using a four-qubit model.

    OutcomeTop 10 hackathon finalist; evaluation uses 39 OASIS-1 subjects and does not establish quantum advantage.
